correctness.rationale: Stationary covariance solves K_b Sigma+Sigma K_b=2 diag(1,1+d) uniquely for |b|<1, giving the specified Gaussian snapshot FI F(z,d), z=b². Independently checked symbolic Lyapunov solution, Gaussian Fisher trace identity, and exact derivative factorization ∂zF proportional to cubic P(z,d) with negative denominator. P(0,d)<0, P(1,d)<0, and P_zz<0 on 0<=z<=1; hence only zero or two interior simple roots or one double root. P/d^4=A(z)-sum_{j=1}^4 B_j(z)/d^j with all B_j>0; the maximum is continuous and strictly increasing from negative to positive, so there is exactly one transition at d*=33.219537333... z*=0.1389386404..., which independently solves P=P_z=0. Nondegenerate double root gives square-root split; large d root scaling z_-~4/(3d), z_+→(9-sqrt57)/4. Formula is for known d, not the marginalized nuisance Fisher information. Critical numerical digits are uncertified approximations; uniqueness is analytic.
